'''Business and economy'''
*[[AI boom]]
**[[Artificial intelligence industry in Canada]]
***[[Canada]]'s [[Government of Canada|federal government]] invests up to [[Canadian dollar|C$]]1.6 billion ([[US$]]1.1 billion) in [[Toronto]]-based [[artificial intelligence]] company [[Cohere]], taking an [[equity stake]] as part of a C$7 billion (US$5 billion) [[funding round]] intended to expand domestic [[computing infrastructure]] and [[AI development]]. [https://www.afp.com/en/canada-buying-stake-ai-firm-cohere-bolster-tech-sovereignty (AFP)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/ottawa-takes-stake-cohere-ai-company-opens-45-billion-funding-round-2026-10-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**[[KuCoin]] ends services for customers in [[Russia]] and [[Belarus]], citing sanctions. [https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/10/29/kucoin-suspends-services-in-russia-and-belarus-with-immediate-effect/ (''The Crypto Times'')]
*[[Christine Lagarde]], the [[president of the European Central Bank]], resigns, saying she could not remain neutral on current events. She will step down from office in February 2027, eight months before her term officially ends. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/ecb-hold-rates-investors-focus-french-bonds-lagardes-future-2026-10-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Swedish government formation]]
**[[Andreas Norlén]], [[Speaker of the Riksdag|speaker]] of the [[Sweden|Swedish]] [[Riksdag|parliament]], announces a second vote to elect the next [[Prime Minister of Sweden|prime minister]]. He proposes a [[Coalition government|coalition]] led by the [[Centre Party (Sweden)|Center Party]]'s leader, [[Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist]], alongside the [[Social Democratic Party of Sweden|Social Democrats]], [[Green Party of Sweden|Greens]], [[Christian Democrats (Sweden)|Christian Democrats]], and the [[Moderate Party (Sweden)|Moderates]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/swedish-parliament-vote-centre-party-leader-prime-minister-despite-gridlock-2026-10-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[2027 Haitian general election]]
**[[Haiti]]'s [[Provisional Electoral Council]] sets the [[Two-round system|first round]] of [[President of Haiti|presidential]] and [[National Assembly (Haiti)|legislative]] elections for August 29, 2027, with a second round scheduled for December 5, as the country prepares for its first [[Elections in Haiti|national elections]] since [[2015–17 Haitian parliamentary election|2017]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20261029-gang-plagued-haiti-sets-election-dates-for-2027 (AFP via RFI)]
